question: What INSUNITS scalar values can libdxfrw represent in DXF and DWG headers without truncation or silent omission?

findings: INSUNITS is an integer system variable stored in the drawing.
The documented INSUNITS codes are the contiguous range 0 through 24.
The DXF HEADER stores INSUNITS using group code 70.
Autodesk documents code 21 as supported for insertion/attachment starting with AutoCAD 2017-based products; earlier products treat it as unitless.
Autodesk documents codes 22, 23, and 24 as supported on AutoCAD for Mac only.

implementation.publicApi: DRW_Header::Units now names USSurveyFoot=21, USSurveyInch=22, USSurveyYard=23, USSurveyMile=24, and UnitCount=25. DRW_Header::measurement classifies all four survey values as English units.
implementation.dxfOutput: Validate canonical dollar/bare aliases, integer type, group 70, and the 0-24 range. Refuse an explicit INSUNITS value for targets before AC1015, where the writer would otherwise omit it.
implementation.dwgOutput: DRW_Header::encodeDwgForWriter validates aliases, type, group 70, and range before changing the output streams; invalid values cannot be narrowed to UInt16 silently.
implementation.input: Tolerant DXF parsing remains unchanged and retains unsupported integer source values for diagnosis.

coverage: ASCII and Binary DXF output/readback for every value 0 through 24.
Absent value, invalid negative/25/INT_MAX values, wrong type/group, duplicate aliases, lowercase alias, and custom-variable placement.
Tolerant DXF input retention for code 25.
Atomic DXF refusal and corrected same-writer retry.
Refusal rather than silent omission on pre-AC1015 DXF targets.
DWG header encoding accepts representative values 0, 20, 21, and 24 and refuses -1/25 without emitting bits for all six supported writer revisions.

qualificationLimit: These controls qualify scalar representation and admission only. They do not verify insertion-scale calculations, unit conversion factors, native consumer behavior, or platform support for codes 21-24. In particular, the Autodesk platform/version restrictions remain separate consumer gates.
